about_the_game:
Consider or DIE
Extra content that awakens your hidden survival instincts.


Survival Instinct.
It’s that gut feeling we’ve had since the caveman days—the power to sense danger and stay alive.
When things go seriously wrong, reading the room becomes a matter of life or death.

■ What’s This Game About?
This is extra content for KUUKIYOMI 4: Let’s Play Together, and it’s all about one thing: high-stakes situations.

From small everyday mess-ups to zombie outbreaks and even alien encounters—this world is full of chaos.
Take control of the red object on screen and face 30 brand-new, slightly more dangerous scenarios than usual.

■ Game Modes
・"Consider It" mode
Go through 30 non-stop do-or-die situations.
At the end, you’ll get a rating of how well you can read the room when it really counts.
Play again and again to train your survival instincts.

・“Consider It Together” mode.
Tackle 10 intense scenarios with a friend or family member.
Work together, stay in sync, and see how well you vibe as a team!
